title: mc improvements
description: this modpack aims to make improvements to minecraft without changing the base game too much or lowering preformance a lot
body:
this modpack aims to make improvements to minecraft without changing the base game too much or lowering preformance a lot


this modpack was made to be a fun, lightweight singleplayer/multiplayer experience.
the included economy features improve the multiplayer experience.
with the list of added mods there are various different things you can do,
it all depends on how you want to play.

adds some mods including, but not limited to:
create (and various addons),
farmers delight,
better end & nether,
levelz (and most of the compatability mods for it),
larion (for world generation),
simply swords,
essential,
sodium + various other optimization mods


may be missing some levelz compatability mods
i will be updating this sometimes.
currently no plans to port to other mod loaders such as forge because of preformance issues
